value.Title: HICP
value.Description: Index number that measures the price change of goods and services purchased by consumers for their own consumption on Dutch territory.

value.Title: HICP constant taxes
value.Description: The HICP constant taxes excludes the effect of changes in the rates of product-related taxes (e.g. VAT and duty on alcohol and tobacco) and subsidies.

value.Title: Monthly rate of change HICP
value.Description: Percentage change of the HICP compared with previous month.

value.Title: Monthly rate of change HICP-CT
value.Description: Percentage change of the HICP constant taxes compared with previous month.

value.Title: Annual rate of change HICP
value.Description: Percentage change of the HICP compared with the same period previous year.

value.Title: Annual rate of change HICP-CT
value.Description: Percentage change of the HICP constant taxes compared with the same period previous year.

value.Title: Weighting coefficient
value.Description: The weighting coefficient reflects the share (in hundred thousandths) of the total consumer expenditure.
